timeline.summary: Promoter **Rajinder Gupta**, **Madhuraj Foundation**, **Lotus Global Foundation**, and **Trident Group Limited** declared no encumbrances on Trident Limited shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,632.53 Cr (-12.4% YoY), net profit ₹101.98 Cr (-23.6% YoY).
Trident approved a ₹500 Cr NCD fundraising, re-appointed Deepak Nanda as MD, and dropped plans for a domestic subsidiary.
On May 25, 2026, Trident Limited announced the resignation of Chief Financial Officer Avneesh Barua, effective May 29, 2026.
Trident Limited received the TEXPROCIL Gold Trophy for Highest Global Exports on May 25, 2026.

Trident's Q1FY27 investor presentation (25 July 2026) showed consolidated total income up 4.42% YoY to ₹1,803 Cr and net profit up 12.96% to ₹158 Cr, with textile EBIT margin up 378 bps and Paper & Chemical EBIT margin down 1,061 bps.
